earliest_visible_sign.description: Small oval, pale green, yellowish, or water-soaked spots

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Long elliptical, spindle-shaped, or cigar-shaped lesions that run broadly parallel to leaf veins

colors.color_progression: Grey-green lesions that mature to grey, tan, or straw-brown

shape.shape_progression: Oval spots elongate into elliptical or cigar-shaped lesions, becoming irregular after coalescence

size.size_variation_note: Dimensions vary with cultivar, infection timing, weather, and disease severity

texture_and_surface.sporulation_or_sign: Dark grey or olive fungal sporulation visible in humid weather, especially on lesion undersides

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Extensive leaf blighting and premature drying
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Lesions enlarge and merge into irregular necrotic areas
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: Large parts of the leaf become brown, dry, and brittle; whole leaves may wither and die
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Severe infections can affect most of the foliage

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: Usually starts on lower leaves and progresses upward
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: can affect most of the foliage

pathognomonic_features: Long cigar-shaped lesions 3-15 cm long, tapering at the ends
Grey-green lesions maturing to tan with dark grey or olive sporulation on the underside
